changelog: fix (ONT-WGS, pipeline 1.0.1): (1) 16S genus is now the majority genus of all reference names tied at the best identity, not the single top hit — a mislabelled 'Klebsiella pneumoniae' entry in emu_db_mar2026 that is 100 % identical to Acinetobacter 16S made OP-SCN1 read 'Klebsiella sp.'; minority-genus matches are listed as likely mislabelled entries. (2) 16S 'resolved' uses the full tie list per copy (the CSV column is cut at 8 names), so a copy tying ~30 B. cereus group species no longer yields one species. (3) Circular replicons < 1 Mb that MOB-suite calls 'chromosome' (Bacillus / Priestia megaplasmids) are reported as 'plasmid (putative)' instead of 'contig'; summary shows plasmids (+putative). (4) CheckM2 version no longer read from a TensorFlow timestamp. (5) Run notes list each general warning once. (6) GTDB / CheckM2 / Bakta databases downloaded into databases/wgs but not registered in db_paths.json are found and used automatically. Needs a backend restart; Re-analyse existing WGS jobs to apply.

previous.changelog: new: ONT-WGS — whole-genome analysis of bacterial isolates sequenced with ONT Native Barcoding / Ligation kits (e.g. SQK-NBD114-24). Chunk files from MinKNOW are merged per sample automatically and named after the sample folder (Sample_OP-SCN5 → OP-SCN5) or the barcode, fastq_fail files are left out, and sample_map.csv records which file went where. Per sample: read QC/filter (seqkit, read-GC purity check), Flye assembly, Medaka polishing (bacterial model), contig/circularity/depth table, CheckM2, species by sourmash vs GTDB + skani ANI to the closest reference, all full-length 16S copies (barrnap → vsearch, ties reported honestly), MLST, AMRFinderPlus (--plus, organism-aware), VFDB, MOB-suite + PlasmidFinder, Bakta annotation, and an HTML/PDF genome report with a chromosome map. Steps resume after a failure; missing tools are skipped with a note. New: use a folder on the analysis computer instead of uploading (files are linked, not copied); uploads now stream to disk instead of RAM. License keys gain bit 8 (ONT-WGS) — existing keys are unchanged and keep their pipelines; keygen.py issues keys with it. Install the tools once with: bash ~/r16s-app/setup_wgs.sh. Needs a backend restart and frontend build.
